roster.name: MiAIRR (Minimal Information about an AIRR study)
roster.description: Minimal reporting standard describing the metadata elements required to interpret AIRR-seq studies (study/sample/subject, experimental design, library generation, sequencing and processing). Includes mappings and NCBI submission templates.

roster.name: AIRR Rearrangement Schema (V(D)J Sequences)
roster.description: Tabular file-format and field-level schema for representing annotated V(D)J rearranged receptor sequences (columns for gene calls, alignments, CDRs, positions, junction lengths, CIGAR strings and file encoding/dialect rules).

roster.name: AIRR Repertoire Schema (metadata)
roster.description: Schema for high-level repertoire metadata (Repertoire objects including study, subject, sample, data_processing and sequencing files), with YAML/JSON examples for representing repertoire-level metadata.

roster.name: AIRR Data Representation / Formats (AIRR Formats)
roster.description: On-disk/in-transit representation specifications (TSV/TSV dialect, AIRR Model Data File JSON/YAML, encoding rules, required header/columns and rules for custom columns) that define how AIRR schema objects are serialized.

roster.name: AIRR Data Schema (overall)
roster.description: Comprehensive AIRR Schema / OpenAPI definitions (versioned schema set) that define object types (Repertoire, Rearrangement, GermlineSet, GenotypeSet, Clone, etc.), CURIE maps and ontology/identifier conventions across AIRR standards.

roster.name: Germline & Genotype Schema (GermlineSet, GenotypeSet)
roster.description: Schemas for representing germline gene/allele sets and inferred genotypes (GermlineSet and GenotypeSet objects), including allele descriptions, release/version metadata and example JSON structures.

roster.name: Clone Schema
roster.description: Schema defining representation of clonotypes/clonal lineages and clone-level metadata (clone_id, clone_class, nodes, clone counts), with example YAML test files illustrating validation constraints.

roster.name: Single-cell Schema
roster.description: Schema extensions and fields for representing single-cell AIRR data (single-cell flags, cell_id, per-cell sequencing and paired-chain information) within the AIRR metadata model.

roster.name: Reactivity & Receptor Schema
roster.description: Schema for capturing receptor reactivity and receptor-group representations (links to IEDB receptor/epitope identifiers and fields to describe antigen-specificity and reactivity metadata).

roster.name: AIRR Data Commons API (ADC API)
roster.description: Machine-queryable REST API specification for searching, faceting and retrieving AIRR data from repositories (ADC API endpoints, query filters, examples and response formats).
